wholePhysicalScope: The named mosque outline follows the prayer halls and arcades around the courtyard. Its attached north range and the pavilion inside the same site come from individual OSM ways.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open courtyard, vaulted portals, roofed entry turrets and the central pavilion. Near levels refine the pointed arches, tile bands and vaults.
limitations: The mosque outline, attached north range and separate courtyard pavilion are mapped. The partition of the prayer halls and the positions and heights of the west, south and east inner portals are estimates.

The public-domain north iwan and pavilion photos guide the architectural features, colors and material contrast. Tile designs, the calligraphic frieze, roofs and ornamental detail are simplified. No text is reproduced.
The exterior includes the open courtyard as the mosque’s architectural setting. The adjacent Shah Cheragh shrine and other separate sites are excluded.
